title: Reject invalid configured filters without silently changing common report requests
description: Stage 1 common report configuration platform failure handling only. Verified rccBuildFilter returns null for numeric abc and rccBuildDefinition filters out null; typed in-list 1,abc,2 silently becomes 1,2. Fix configured filter validation and action handling as one generic increment, not a bespoke business report. Client must not broaden or change intended query due to invalid input. Keep server catalog/row/column/data scope authoritative; no new grants, SQL, arbitrary relations, business writes or special report endpoints. Preserve unsaved edits and existing OperationLogMiddleware audit on valid API actions. No persistence/schema/migration/SchemaUpgrader/SeedData edits, real database execution, production SQL, deployment, secrets/.env/config modifications or Agent work. Execute offline Node behavior fixtures (Node is installed) integrated into existing .NET unit tests; static source assertions alone are insufficient. Real browser and database acceptance remains environment blocked; build never completes the whole phase. Preserve unrelated work.
acceptance_criteria: Configured filter rows must fail closed on missing/unknown field or operator, invalid numeric/boolean/date values, incomplete or reversed between bounds and any invalid in-list member. Never drop a configured filter or silently shrink its values; clearing/removing a row is an explicit user action.

Save and every common preview/export submission catch filter validation failures before network requests, show actionable row feedback and preserve edits; busy/request sequencing remains recoverable and valid numeric zero, boolean false and complete typed filter values serialize unchanged. Reuse current ERP permissions and existing audit endpoints.

Execute actual JavaScript helper and submission behavior in offline Node fixtures from the normal unit test suite: invalid filter cannot produce a broader request, mixed valid/invalid in-list cannot silently narrow, invalid between/boolean/date and unknown catalog keys fail; valid filters and corrections pass, no network request for invalid save. Safe Release build/test passes; missing real browser/database acceptance is explicitly environment blocked.
